words.definition: the customs, art, and way of life of a group of people
words.example: Each country has its own culture.

words.definition: a custom that people have followed for a long time
words.example: It is a tradition to eat special food at New Year.

words.definition: a usual way of doing something in a place or culture
words.example: Taking off your shoes at home is a common custom.

words.definition: a formal event held for a special occasion
words.example: We went to a wedding ceremony last weekend.

words.definition: to do something special for an important day or event
words.example: We celebrate my grandmother's birthday every year.

words.definition: a group of people born around the same time
words.example: Three generations of my family live in this house.

words.definition: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
words.example: We remember our ancestors during this festival.

words.definition: special clothes worn for a festival or celebration
words.example: The dancers wore colorful traditional costumes.

words.definition: a system of belief in a god or gods
words.example: Many traditions come from religion.

words.definition: an idea that people think is true
words.example: This custom comes from an old belief.

words.definition: a feeling of admiration for someone or something
words.example: We show respect to older people in our culture.

words.definition: an idea about what is important in life
words.example: Family is an important value in many cultures.

words.definition: the traditions and history that a group of people share
words.example: This old building is part of our cultural heritage.

words.definition: a ceremony where two people get married
words.example: Her sister's wedding was a beautiful ceremony.

words.definition: a set of movements you do to music
words.example: They performed a traditional dance at the festival.

words.definition: traditional, made by ordinary people over a long time
words.example: We listened to folk music from the countryside.

words.definition: the words people use to speak and write
words.example: Language is an important part of every culture.

words.definition: to say hello to someone in a friendly way
words.example: In this culture, people greet each other with a bow.

words.definition: an older person, especially one who is respected
words.example: We always listen carefully to our elders.

words.definition: something that represents an idea or thing
words.example: The dragon is a symbol in many Asian cultures.

text: Every country has its own culture, and culture includes many things: language, food, music, and tradition. Traditions are customs that pass from one generation to the next, often starting with our ancestors many years ago. For example, in some cultures, people wear a special costume for a wedding or another important ceremony. Families celebrate these events together, and everyone shows respect for the older members, called elders, who often teach the younger generation about their history and beliefs. In many places, religion also plays a big part in local traditions and ceremonies. Music and dance are important too. Folk music and traditional dances tell stories about the past and are often performed during festivals and celebrations. Many symbols, like special colors or animals, also have deep meaning in a culture. These symbols help people remember their heritage and values. Learning about different cultures and their traditions helps us understand and respect people from other countries. Even though customs are different around the world, most cultures value family, respect, and celebration in similar ways.
